sections.heading: Cambridge Institute of Technology Ranchi vs XISS Ranchi for MBA / PGDM: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose Cambridge Institute of Technology Ranchi if you want a recorded fee of ₹40,000, and an admission route through CMAT, in a private MBA / PGDM setting at Ranchi.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what the official pages say
paragraphs: On this page we quote a programme total when we hold a Total Fees record, and we skip short, executive or certificate rows when the picker can tell them apart. Always match the fee to the exact programme you will join.

Our records show ₹40,000 as a tuition figure for MBA Finance at Cambridge Institute of Technology Ranchi. Treat this as a recorded tuition figure, not a confirmed two-year total, unless the official notice says otherwise.
Our records show ₹34,500 as a programme total for Post Graduate Programme in Management (PGPM) at XISS Ranchi.

faqs.question: Which is better in 2026, Cambridge Institute of Technology Ranchi or XISS Ranchi?
faqs.answer: It depends on the programme you want. Cambridge Institute of Technology Ranchi and XISS Ranchi differ in more than one way: the useful differences are fees, the admission test and the kind of MBA / PGDM classroom each campus offers.

faqs.question: What are the recorded fees for Cambridge Institute of Technology Ranchi vs XISS Ranchi?
faqs.answer: our records list ₹40,000 for Cambridge Institute of Technology Ranchi on MBA Finance; our records list ₹34,500 for XISS Ranchi on Post Graduate Programme in Management (PGPM). Confirm both official notices before you decide.

faqs.question: How do placements compare for Cambridge Institute of Technology Ranchi and XISS Ranchi?
faqs.answer: We do not hold a 2020-or-later flagship placement year for Cambridge Institute of Technology Ranchi here, so do not treat older or unofficial packages as current.

faqs.question: Which entrance exams do Cambridge Institute of Technology Ranchi and XISS Ranchi accept?
faqs.answer: Our records list CMAT for Cambridge Institute of Technology Ranchi, and XAT for XISS Ranchi. Always confirm the current admission brochure, because tests and cut-offs change by year.

faqs.question: Are Cambridge Institute of Technology Ranchi and XISS Ranchi in the same city?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both are in Ranchi, Jharkhand. The move is about the programme, fees and tests, not a change of city.

faqs.question: Should I treat this comparison as a final admission decision?
faqs.answer: No. Fees, eligibility and placements change by year and by programme. Verify the current official fee notice, admission brochure and placement report of each institute before you apply.
